auth_manual.title: Sign in to Duke Energy
auth_manual.description:
Duke Energy expects a mobile app and blocks desktop browsers, so the browser you sign in with must identify as an iPhone.

1. [Open the Duke Energy sign-in]({authorize_url}).
2. On a desktop browser, switch that tab to an iPhone User-Agent and reload.
   - Chrome or Edge: View → Developer → Developer Tools → ⋮ → Device Emulation → pick an iPhone preset.
   - Safari: Develop → User Agent → pick an iPhone entry. If there is no Develop menu, turn on 'Show features for web developers' in Safari Settings → Advanced.
3. Sign in. Duke then redirects to a `login.duke-energy.com/ios/...` address; the page itself may be blank or show an error.
4. Copy the entire address from the address bar and paste it below.

On an iPhone or iPad, skip step 2. After signing in, long-press the address at the top of the sign-in window and select 'Copy'.

A new tab opens the Duke Energy sign-in. With the HA OAuth Assist extension (or a legacy Duke Energy extension) installed, proceed with sign in and follow the instructions in 'Link to Home Assistant' to finish setup automatically.
Keep this window open.

meter.description:
### Set the cost source for {meter}.

- **Entity price:** the rate in {unit}. A `sensor` uses long-term statistics to price usage over its history; a `number`/`input_number` act as static price.
- **Static price:** a fixed rate in {unit}.
